Container.Name: nzbget-sab-bridge
Container.Overview: Early NZBGet-compatible JSON-RPC API bridge for SABnzbd. API-only, no web UI. Use on a trusted LAN or VPN and configure it with a SABnzbd URL/API key plus bridge credentials. This is not a full NZBGet emulator; iOS compatibility is provisional.
Container.Description: This container exposes a limited NZBGet-compatible JSON-RPC surface in front of SABnzbd. It has no dashboard or web UI. The image runs as non-root UID/GID 10001:10001 and requires a writable /data appdata bind mount. Do not expose the RPC port directly to the Internet. See the project README and compatibility matrix for supported methods and limitations. Not affiliated with or endorsed by NZBGet, SABnzbd, NZBClient, or Unraid.

Config.Name: API port
Config.Description: Host port for the NZBGet-compatible RPC API. Point the client at host port 6790.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite ID map. Must be writable by UID/GID 10001:10001.

Config.Name: Mode
Config.Description: Keep this set to bridge for normal operation. Capture mode is for isolated development only.

Config.Name: Listen host
Config.Description: Container listen address. Keep 0.0.0.0 inside Docker.

Config.Name: Listen port
Config.Description: Container listen port. Change the host port mapping instead.

Config.Name: SABnzbd URL
Config.Description: Reachable SABnzbd base URL, for example http://sabnzbd:8080 or a reverse-proxy URL. Do not put credentials in this URL.

Config.Name: SABnzbd API key
Config.Description: Full SABnzbd API key, not the NZB key. Required.

Config.Name: Bridge username
Config.Description: Username the client uses to authenticate to the bridge.

Config.Name: Bridge password
Config.Description: Password the client uses to authenticate to the bridge. Required.

Config.Name: Verify TLS
Config.Description: Verify outbound TLS certificates. Disable only for a deliberately trusted test setup.

Config.Name: Check SAB on readiness
Config.Description: Include a bounded SABnzbd connectivity check in /readyz.

Config.Name: Readiness timeout
Config.Description: Seconds allowed for the readiness backend check.

Config.Name: HTTP connect timeout
Config.Description: SABnzbd connection timeout in seconds.

Config.Name: HTTP read timeout
Config.Description: SABnzbd read timeout in seconds.

Config.Name: HTTP write timeout
Config.Description: SABnzbd write timeout in seconds.

Config.Name: HTTP pool timeout
Config.Description: SABnzbd connection-pool timeout in seconds.

Config.Name: Request body limit
Config.Description: Maximum incoming RPC body in bytes, including base64 and JSON overhead.

Config.Name: Decoded NZB limit
Config.Description: Decoded NZB ceiling in bytes. The effective limit can be lower because of base64 and JSON overhead.

Config.Name: SAB response limit
Config.Description: Maximum buffered SABnzbd JSON response body in bytes.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: CRITICAL, ERROR, WARNING, INFO, or DEBUG.

Config.Name: Log format
Config.Description: json or human.

Config.Name: Advertised NZBGet profile
Config.Description: Only 21.1 is supported.
